sinopsis.es: Barbara Kopple, directora de Harlan County, U.S.A., observa tres batallas laborales decisivas en Nueva York, con trabajadores de UPS, de Amazon y repartidores de DoorDash y GrubHub.
sinopsis.en: Barbara Kopple (TIFF ’76’s Harlan County, U.S.A.) looks at three crucial labour battles as they unfold in New York City involving workers from UPS, Amazon, and deliveristas for DoorDash and GrubHub.
